transcript: Speaker A: Hey Yesenia, keep up the great work! See you at the team meeting on Tuesday... I mean, Wednesday. Blessings, Bryce. Speaker A: Write me a summary of all last week's meetings.
summary: The ad demonstrates the Wispr Flow voice dictation app on an iPhone. A user speaks naturally, making a correction mid-sentence, and the app seamlessly transcribes the polished text into an email and then into Claude. The ad concludes with a call to action to download Wispr Flow.
